text: Resizing the top-level window does not directly establish the embedded browser client size. The tree-view setup waits for the minimum client width/height before loading and focusing the test content. The fixed dimensions differ from the historical patch, so preserve the state predicate and local harness needs rather than a fixed-size rule. The suspected first-run layout cause and later failure reports remain uncertain. No layout or test ran.
title: Tree widget tests wait for the inner viewport after outer resize
